name: Asadullah Imran
title: Aspiring Researcher · AI · Machine Learning · Computational Biology
tagline: Developing deep learning and computational biology approaches to understand complex cellular systems
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
about: I am a Computer Science and Engineering student at United International University, Bangladesh, with a major in Data Science. My interests lie at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, and Computational Biology. I am particularly interested in developing machine learning approaches that can address complex scientific problems and extract meaningful insights from high-dimensional biological data. Currently, I am working on a research project focused on deep learning for spatial multi-omics cell clustering, exploring representation learning and computational approaches for understanding complex cellular environments. Throughout my undergraduate journey, I have maintained a CGPA of 3.97/4.00 and received multiple academic merit scholarships for outstanding academic performance. Beyond coursework, I am continuously developing my research capabilities through experimentation, technical learning, scientific literature, and interdisciplinary exploration. My long-term goal is to pursue graduate research and contribute to the development of AI-driven methods that advance scientific discovery.
